description: Change one of your Canvas planner notes: its title, details, date or course. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

note_id.description: Planner note ID, from list_planner_notes or list_planner_items (plannable_id of a planner_note).
